name: Payment Identification
definition: Specifies the different identifications associated with a payment transaction.

ExecutionIdentification.name: Execution Identification
ExecutionIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a payment execution, as assigned by the clearing agent or the initiating party.

EndToEndIdentification.name: End To End Identification
EndToEndIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a payment as assigned by the originator. The payment transaction reference is used for reconciliation or to link tasks relating to the payment.

InstructionIdentification.name: Instruction Identification
InstructionIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by an instructing party for an instructed party to unambiguously identify the instruction.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the first instructing agent to unambiguously identify the transaction and passed on, unchanged, throughout the entire interbank chain.

ClearingSystemReference.name: Clearing System Reference
ClearingSystemReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a payment instruction, as assigned by the clearing system.

CreditorReference.name: Creditor Reference
CreditorReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous reference assigned by the creditor to refer to the payment obligation.

UETR.name: UETR
UETR.definition: Universally unique identifier to provide an end-to-end reference of a payment transaction.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Payment for which identifications are provided.
